info.title: Tianji Process Automation v2
info.description: Public Process automation contract for design, activation, execution, event admission, human tasks and worker leases. The owner, tenant and producer are derived from current verified identity. Host validation also enforces schema/reference relations, UTF-8 byte limits, canonical encodings and exact permissions.

oauth2.description: Illustrative endpoints. Deployments supply their own identity endpoints, and the PS validates the current resource and principal in addition to scope.

CommandId.description: Stable command identifier, scoped by trusted actor and operation.

OpaqueText128.description: Exact nonblank text. The host validates the Java UTF-16 length and prohibits control characters.

OpaqueText255.description: Exact nonblank text. The host validates the Java UTF-16 length and prohibits control characters.

Base64UrlToken32.description: Unpadded Base64URL of 32 random bytes, encoded as 43 characters. The trusted host validates the token identity and representation. Treat it as opaque and never log it.

UtcInstant.description: UTC, seconds required, at most six fractional digits, and no leap seconds or numeric offset.

ExactPositiveInteger.description: Exact JSON integer token, with no decimal or exponent notation.

ExactNonnegativeInteger.description: Exact JSON integer token, with no decimal or exponent notation.

TypedDataObject.description: Business members are constrained by the frozen and authorized input or output schema. Duplicate keys, U+0000, invalid Unicode and non-integral numeric tokens are rejected. The host enforces depth <= 8 and canonical UTF-8 size <= 64 KiB where used as a full business object.

pattern.description: Search semantics. Only ASCII literals, escaped metacharacters, non-negated ASCII classes and ranges, optional absolute anchors, and bounded ? or {n} / {m,n} repetitions. The host validates the syntax and total expanded width <= 128.

format.description: date uses a valid ISO YYYY-MM-DD. date-time is UTC Z with seconds and at most six fractional digits. decimal:<scale> is a signed decimal string with no exponent, plus sign or redundant leading zeros, no excess scale and no rounding. Normalize to the declared scale and positive zero.

ProcessSchemaVO.description: Closed schema subset. Objects require additionalProperties=false and declared required names. Maximum schema size 32 KiB UTF-8. Maximum value depth 8. No external references, group/combinator keywords, floating-point inputs or executable expressions. The host enforces ordered bounds and the portable string pattern subset.

target.description: Closed dotted path, with fixed zero-based array indices and at most eight segments including subscripts.

source.description: Fixed path in input, scope, nodes.<nodeId>.output, or event. Arbitrary expressions are not permitted.

AgentTaskBindingVO.description: The exact default dependency must be an allowed template. Only declared parameters are overridable, and defaults must satisfy the frozen parameter schema.

dueAfter.description: ISO-8601 duration. The operation validates the semantic positivity and duration ordering described by its enclosing contract.

target.description: Closed dotted path, with fixed zero-based array indices and at most eight segments including subscripts.

path.description: Closed dotted path, with fixed zero-based array indices and at most eight segments including subscripts.

ConditionVO.description: Closed condition AST. Maximum depth 8 and 64 total nodes. No script or arbitrary expression.

backoff.description: ISO-8601 duration. The operation validates the semantic positivity and duration ordering described by its enclosing contract.

RetryPolicyVO.description: Backoff is nonnegative, at most PT1H. Unknown side effects never authorize automatic retries.

nodeTimeout.description: ISO-8601 duration. The operation validates the semantic positivity and duration ordering described by its enclosing contract.

attemptTimeout.description: ISO-8601 duration. The operation validates the semantic positivity and duration ordering described by its enclosing contract.

dispatchTimeout.description: ISO-8601 duration. The operation validates the semantic positivity and duration ordering described by its enclosing contract.

NodePolicyVO.description: Positive elapsed durations, dispatchTimeout <= attemptTimeout <= nodeTimeout <= P30D. BRANCH targets are fixed and stay within scope.

AutomationNodeBindingVO.description: AND_JOIN is only the logical parallel join. A fork does not take a binding. Each merge target is unique and belongs to the current scope. MULTI_INSTANCE also places merge at this same top level.

interval.description: ISO-8601 duration. The operation validates the semantic positivity and duration ordering described by its enclosing contract.

ScheduleVO.description: The first of endAt or maxOccurrences bounds this schedule. If both are specified, stop at the earlier bound.

ttl.description: ISO-8601 duration. The operation validates the semantic positivity and duration ordering described by its enclosing contract.

EventRouteVO.description: The route and source are frozen on release. TTL is positive and at most P30D. sourceRef identifies the trusted producer registration, rather than a URL or credential.

AutomationModelSourceVO.description: Strict release source projection. The host bounds the combined UTF-8 model XML to 4 MiB and validates exact declared model, node and route identities.

GraphVO.description: Logical IDs and safe presentation text only. The host validates unique nodes and edges and resolves each edge to declared endpoints.

DraftPublicationVO.description: publishedRevision is the original pre-seal draft revision. draftRevision is the sealed draft revision.

AutomationStartCommand.description: Selects the current active release by definitionKey and verified tenant. The raw request digest preserves sent strings and integer tokens before typed normalization. Only an omitted overrides object defaults to {}.

AutomationInstanceDTO.description: Release and activation revision remain pinned. Business output is non-null only on completion, with current DATA_READ and the applicable host data policy.

ProcessNodeExecutionDTO.description: deadlineAt is the current attempt's hard deadline. Associated AgentRun ID requires current DIAGNOSTIC_READ. Business data requires separate current DATA_READ. UNKNOWN never implies safe re-dispatch.

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor bound to the current authorized scope and query filters.

ProcessEventCommand.description: The bound server route determines its mode. START requires explicit null waitToken. SIGNAL requires the exact current reservation's canonical waitToken. The input supplies no releaseVersion or trusted producer identity. occurredAt does not extend the delivery deadline.

ProcessEventReceiptDTO.description: Admission and receipt preserve the originally pinned release, activation revision and time. APPLIED denotes committed exact native evidence.

result.description: Validated by the human task's immutable resultSchema. Business content remains behind an allowed resultRef.

reason.description: Nonblank reason. The host enforces the Java UTF-16 length limit.

NodeRetryCommand.description: The receipt reference is only a lookup hint. Only the registered host authority can establish a retry-safe business effect.

AutomationWorkerTaskDTO.description: The separately validated taskContractSha256 binds the trusted tenant/source and all other task members in AUTOMATION_WORKER_TASK_V2. The lease token contributes only its decoded-byte SHA-256. Recovery evidence does not create permission to dispatch by itself.

DraftModelSourceVO.description: Draft text may be incomplete. The server validates the exact model name and XML when validating or publishing the saved revision.

DraftContentVO.description: Preserve unfinished XML and JSON editor text verbatim, including whitespace. The whole canonical UTF-8 draft content is limited to 4 MiB.

title.description: Nonblank title without control characters. Preserve all input whitespace without trimming.

SaveProcessDraftCommand.description: The save request HTTP body is at most 5 MiB. Only a draft in EDITING at expectedRevision accepts a new save.

AutomationActivationDTO.description: Each accepted new command creates the next definition-activation revision. It does not mutate previously admitted runs.
